<function name="IsUserGroup" parent="Player" type="classfunc">
	<description>Returns whether the player is in specified group or not. See <page>Player:GetUserGroup</page> for a way to get player's user group.</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<file line="32-L38">lua/includes/extensions/player_auth.lua</file>
	<args>
		<arg name="groupName" type="string">Group to check the player for.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">`true` if the player has the given user group.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Prints in the players console "yes, I'm awesome!" if he's in the superadmin group.</description>
	<code>
if ( Entity( 1 ):IsUserGroup( "superadmin" ) ) then
    print( "Yes, I'm awesome!" )
end
	</code>
	<output>"Yes, I'm awesome!" in console.</output>

</example>
